Shri N.S. Solanki - Panel Lawyer for the respondent/State.

Order 
This is fourth application filed by the applicant under Section 483 of BNSS, 2023 (Section 439 of the Cr.P.C., 1973) for grant of regular bail relating to FIR No.213/2023, dated 22.04.2023, registered at Police Station - Sarani, District Betul (M.P.) for commission of offence punishable under Sections 366, 376(2)(n), 376(3), 376DA, 368 and 506 of IPC and Section 5(I), 5(g) and 6 of POCSO Act, 2012 and Section 3(1)(W)(ii), 3(2)(v) of the SC/ST (POA) Act.
Applicant is in detention since 05.07.2023.
Applicants first bail application was dismissed as withdrawn and not pressed vide order dated 16.08.2023 passed in M.Cr.C.No.28339/2023.

Second bail application was also dismissed as withdrawn and not pressed with the direction to the trial Court to complete the trial expeditiously as early as possible vide order dated NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2024:MPHC-JBP:61147 2 MCRC-49329-2024 05.02.2024 passed in M.Cr.C.No.56962/2023.

Third bail application was also dismissed as withdrawn and not pressed and trial Court was directed to conclude the trial within a period of three months and liberty was granted that if within the aforesaid period trial is not concluded applicant shall be at liberty to renew the prayer for bail vide order dated 23.07.2024 passed in M.Cr.C.No.17391/2024.
2

As per the prosecution story, on 22.04.2023 at around 03:00 P.M., 15 years and 10 months old prosecutrix was going towards friend's house to handover her copy when she reached at Shobhapur Shahbaz Khan vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 12 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/39377036/
1 Club, near SBI Bank her friends brother Suraj alias Aman along with his friend Shahbaz riding on motorcycle bearing registration No.M.P.-48-MJ-3539 came and took her to Firoj home and they both served her cold drink and thereafter Suraj repeatedly committed rape upon her and Shahbaz threatened not to disclose incident of rape to any one.

sentences.text: FIR was registered.
3. Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that applicant is in jail for the last 1 year and 5 months and in this period trial could not be concluded.
Therefore, on the delay ground bail has been prayed.
It is submitted that the main allegations are against Suraj and only allegation of threat is against him.
Therefore, it is prayed that applicant may be released on bail, pending the trial.
4 . On the other hand, learned counsel for the State has opposed the prayer for grant of bail to the applicant.

5. Applicant is in detention for more then 1 year and 5 months and only NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2024:MPHC-JBP:61147 3 MCRC-49329-2024 18 witnesses have been examined so far out of 22 witnesses cited by the prosecution, final conclusion of the trial will take considerable time.
Therefore having taken into consideration all the facts and circumstances of the case, but without expressing anything on the merits of the case, I deem it a fit case for grant of bail.
Consequently, this bail application under Section 483 of BNSS, 2023 (Section 439 of Cr.P.C., 1973) for grant of bail filed on behalf of applicant, stands allowed.

6. It is directed that applicant - Shahbaz Khan be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for his regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.

He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under[Section 480(3) of BNSS, 2023 [Section 437(3) of Cr.P.C., 1973].
7.
This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case of bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.
